text:
Type: black four-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for decor; bedroom, living room, dressing area
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: black lacquered wood and fiberboard, antique brass bar handles
Colors: deep black, warm antique brass
Shape: upright chest with four wide drawers, each with two small brass bar pulls, framed drawer fronts with thin raised edges, overhanging molded top, heavy molded plinth base, solid and stately
Feel: elegant, formal, rich, dramatic
Goes with: dark walls or crisp white walls, velvet, brass and marble accents; classic, traditional or glam bedrooms

product.name: UNDREDAL
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
